title: Google fixed more Chrome bugs in June than over the past two years, thanks to AI
summary: Google leveraged AI to dramatically accelerate Chrome security bug detection and fixes, addressing more vulnerabilities in June than in the previous two years combined. The AI-powered approach has transformed their security vulnerability management process.
problem_solved: Chrome security vulnerabilities were being discovered and patched too slowly, leaving users exposed to potential exploits for extended periods.
why_valuable: This demonstrates AI's transformative potential in cybersecurity, enabling faster vulnerability identification that protects billions of Chrome users worldwide.
